glosses: in der Art eines Professors, sich wie ein Professor verhaltend

examples.text: „Er war von kleiner Statur, leicht vornübergebeugt, von professoralem Äußeren, hatte einen gepflegten grauen Bart, und hinter der Goldrandbrille funkelten graublaue Augen.“

translations.source_sense_description: in der Art eines Professors, sich wie ein Professor verhaltend

glosses: Of, relating to, or characteristic of a professor or professors, or of a professorship or professorships.

examples.text: David and I were not "intimate" friends. There was always a certain old-worldly formality about our interchanges. There was something professorial and distant about David, something that commanded respect, partially, I think, because he was so respectful himself.

Adamant that women could not enter the professorial fraternity, [[w:Cornell University|Cornell [University]]] did not appoint any women professors until 1911 and then only in home economics. Comstock regained her professorial title only in 1913, after working for many years as a lecturer (Conable 127, 130).

Professorial, downright dorktastic African-American NBA [National Basketball Association] stars are defying the expectation that they wear an intimidating hood facade, which is changing how we view black athletes—and how they view themselves.

translations.source_sense_description: in der Art eines Professors, sich wie ein Professor verhaltend

glosses: Relatif à la qualité ou à la condition de professeur.

examples.text: Notre moniteur avait entretenu une liaison épisodique avec Sylvia du temps où elle habitait en région parisienne. […]. Il semble que ce don Juan des courts ait profité de sa fonction professorale pour séduire un grand nombre de ses élèves.
